A default value is used when the argument is left out. You can only leave out arguments at the end of a call. If a required parameter follows, the caller has to write `createUser(undefined, "Ada")` to get the default.

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```js
function createUser(role = "member", name) {
  return { name, role };
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```js
function createUser(name, role = "member") {
  return { name, role };
}

function log(level = "info", ...messages) {
  console[level](...messages);
}
```
